### GONNA STEAL YOUR HEARTS LIKE YOU STOLE OUR LAND

#### BLAK SOCIAL IS

## **AN INDIGENOUS ARTS SPACE DREAMING ACROSS FILM, THEATRE + MUSIC**

Alethea Beetson (Kabi Kabi/Gubbi Gubbi and Wiradjuri) established Blak Social after successfully founding renowned Indigenous youth arts organisation, Digi Youth Arts, to continue creating spaces for the sovereign-led development and presentation of Indigenous stories and connected arts practice.

Since its beginnings in 2020, Blak Social has delivered productions such as Queen’s City, Blak Friday and held a residency at The Tivoli through which it delivered Blak Day Out 2022 and 2023 along with other music centric events. In 2023 Blak Social produced First Nations led alt-rock band Selve’s visual album Red Desert Dream via our label; and will be releasing new music through Blak Social records in 2024.

Blak Social’s next major theatre + film work is Meet Your Maker - details of that epic work will be available soon!

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e4e4e58add2726619f02616/21831bea-9705-488d-b034-f4246eb83e7f/Screenshot+2024-06-01+at+7.29.39+pm.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e4e4e58add2726619f02616/95aa55a9-9514-4fe9-b21b-f559a18206a9/Screenshot+2024-06-01+at+7.31.40+pm.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e4e4e58add2726619f02616/e2019fd0-a18e-48f2-abdf-3e96e550d981/Screenshot+2024-06-01+at+7.30.11+pm.png)

We acknowledge the important role the arts has played, and continues to play on these lands since the very first sunrise. We give thanks to the Elders, activists and artists who paved the way for us to do this work.

Always was, always will be!

## Minimal Hassles

An underground wunderland built for the singular purpose of hosting the Time Of Your Life.

Featuring a Supernatural Amphitheatre, free range camping, BYO everywhere, permanent showers and composting toilets, abundant food stalls, [camping gear hire](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/camping-gear-hire/), and much much more.

## Plenty of Tassels

All singing, all dancing on the same undulation.

More giant spikes of excitement than a quill‑covered monotreme.

The one and only stage, the No Dickhead Policy, The Gift, Sky Show, Meredith Eye and zero commercial messages.

# Lifetime Warranty

Meredith [started in 1991](https://history.mmf.com.au/) as a one-time wig out for a coupla hundred fun-loving friends. So much enjoyment was had that it went down again the next year, and the next, and now, thirty-odd years later, Meredith is primed to happen again, down on the Nolan farm.

Thanks to all the [feedback and ideas](https://feedback.mmf.com.au/) from you and your friends, Meredith self‑propagates.

We guarantee we will continue to listen, fix things if they don’t work, not fix them if they do, and keep on making it all that it should be.

Every ticket includes camping and parking and helps many organisations to [do good things in the district](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/how-you-help-the-district/).

See you in The Sup’,

# BEAM ME UP

To the astral plains for GP Nineteen.

The  [LineUp](https://goldenplains.com.au/#whos-playing) is out.

Second Round Ballot results will be announced shortly.

Next up is  [Online Sales](https://aunty.goldenplains.com.au/ticket-info/online-sales/) on Wednesday 28 October at 11am (AEDT).

If you’re not already, become a [Subscriber](https://subscribe.goldenplains.com.au/).

![Full width image](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Photo5.2_ChipMooney.webp?x40798)

# PLAIN OLD FUN

There’s only one type of ticket. Everyone flies first class.

All singing, all dancing across two days and two nights of rarified reverie.

With no commercial sponsors, free range camping, BYO, the No Dickhead Policy, and One Stage that fits all.

# WHO'S PLAYING?

Ears to the ground, fingers on the tracks, to detect and select the latest and greatest.  
Heaven-sent and custom-cut with the right sounds at the right time across day and night.  
Mother nature on the lights.

Geese Underworld Angine de Poitrine Miss Kaninna Peter Garrett & The Alter Egos Tinariwen Haute & Freddy Westside Cowboy Maria Arnal Peach Dove Ellis daine iKeda Orcutt Shelley Miller Swapmeet Maurice Fulton Station Model Violence Salimata Intermood Shock Corridor Immy Owusu Rydeen & SOVBLKPSSY Tongue Dissolver Nono Gigsta All On The One Stage Storytelling With Uncle Barry Silence Is Golden

![Golden Plains XIX](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/themes/msa-gp-2027/images/redesign/lineup-logo.svg)

Geese. Underworld. Angine de Poitrine. Miss Kaninna. Peter Garrett & The Alter Egos. Tinariwen. Haute & Freddy. Maria Arnal. Westside Cowboy. Peach. Dove Ellis. daine. iKeda. Orcutt Shelley Miller. Swapmeet. Maurice Fulton. Station Model Violence. Salimata. Intermood. Shock Corridor. Immy Owusu. Rydeen & SOVBLKPSSY. Tongue Dissolver. Nono Gigsta. Storytelling With Uncle Barry. All On The One Stage.

![Image on the left](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Oslo_1v3.webp?x40798)

## SIRIUSLY

One of the best places on earth to spend a long weekend, the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre is purpose-built for serious fun.

One stage, spacey space, free-range camping, no curfew, no advertising, the Meredith Eye, the Ecoplex Outdoor Cinema, BYO, abundant food stalls and minimal hassles.

## 19TH HOLE

Every ticket assists regional organisations doing great work in the district. At the festival, eating from the Tucker Tent (and then eating again) helps good things happen for many local groups.

We are grateful to the wonderful town of Meredith and surrounding areas who so graciously help host Golden Plains.

![Image on the right](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Oslo_2v4.webp?x40798)

![Full width image](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Photo2_ChipMooney.webp?x40798)

# GOLD  
STAMP

Golden Plains comes stamped with a Lifetime Guarantee. We promise we will continue to listen, fix things if they’re broken, not fix them if they ain’t, and keep on making Golden glow.

[Write to me](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) about anything, anytime.

I hope to enjoy the pleasure of your company this March.

## THE STAGE BALI DESERVES

Southeast Asia's most anticipated international tattoo convention.

Bali has long been a destination for the world's best tattoo artists and collectors. Studios here are world class. The talent is undeniable. The culture runs deep. Yet for all of that — Bali has never had an international tattoo convention to match its reputation.

Island of Gods is that stage.

IOG exists to connect artists, brands, communities, and tattoo lovers from across the world — and to position Bali, and Indonesia, as a true global center of tattoo culture.

### 過去の記憶を、新たな創造によって未来へ継ぐ。

都市は、ひとつの巨⼤な表現だ。

建築、ファッション、⾳楽、デザイン、アート、広告。創造者たちによる痕跡が折り重なり、街そのものが、記憶のレイヤーとなって今に存在している。

Tokyo Creative Salon 2026のテーマ「FUTURE VINTAGE」は、東京という都市をかたちづくる多様な表現と、その背後にある時間や想いに、敬意をもって向き合いたいという思いから⽣まれました。

FUTURE VINTAGEとは、時代を象徴するスタイルや⽂化のエッセンスを受け継ぎながら、現代ならではの視点やテクノロジーを掛け合わせ、やがて「未来のヴィンテージ」として残り得る新しい表現を創造していくアプローチです。

過去は、懐かしむためのものだけではなく、これからを⽣み出すための起点であり、創造の素材でもあります。過去から何を引き継ぎ、未来に何を残すのか。私たちはいま、創造の本質をもう⼀度⾒つめ直し、世代を超え、その価値を未来へと継承していこうとしています。

## Transforma tu barrio con arte urbano y graffiti

Conecta con artistas, vecinos y aliados para convertir muros olvidados en espacios vibrantes que inspiran, unen y cuentan historias.

[Propón tu mural](https://murales.colorizatubarrio.com/)

## DESDE COLORIZA

Transformamos espacios con arte urbano

![](assets/img/about-coloriza.png)

### ¿Por qué proponer un mural?

¿Tienes una pared pintarrajeada por partidos políticos? ¿Vives en un barrio con muros sucios o abandonados? ¿Conoces un lugar que podría transformarse en arte?

Entonces utiliza nuestro [Simulador de Murales](https://murales.colorizatubarrio.com/) y visualiza el cambio antes de hacerlo realidad, ¿Dónde puedes proponer un mural?

*   En la esquina de tu casa.
*   En alguna pared de tu barrio o ciudad.
*   En un espacio abandonado que merezca vida.

**¿Y si no eres dueño del espacio?**  
No te preocupes, nosotros gestionamos los permisos y buscamos los recursos para hacerlo posible.

[Propón tu mural](https://murales.colorizatubarrio.com/) [Quiero donar](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+51991231559&text=Hola%20COLORIZA,%20%F0%9F%8E%A8%F0%9F%92%AA%F0%9F%8F%BB%F0%9F%98%80%F0%9F%96%8C%EF%B8%8F%20Quiero%20ser%20parte%20del%20proyecto%20Coloriza%20tu%20barrio%E2%80%A6%20)

### Coloriza tu barrio sin prejuicios

En COLORIZA conectamos a ciudadanos, artistas y aliados para revitalizar comunidades a través del arte urbano, recuperando espacios públicos, reduciendo la violencia juvenil y transmitiendo identidad y memoria en cada muro mediante procesos participativos que dejan huella en las personas y el territorio.

  

#### Nuestros objetivos

*   ♻️ Recuperamos espacios públicos.
*   🎨 Promovemos el acceso libre y cercano al arte.
*   🛡️ Reducimos la violencia juvenil a través de actividades creativas.
*   🤝 Conectamos comunidades, artistas e instituciones.
*   🏛️ Revalorizamos símbolos, lenguas y elementos de la identidad local.

[¿Cuáles son los pasos?](https://www.colorizatubarrio.com/#proponer-mural)

![](assets/img/about.png)

![](assets/img/clients/01.png)

![](assets/img/clients/02.png)

![](assets/img/clients/03.png)

![](assets/img/clients/04.png)

![](assets/img/clients/05.png)

![](assets/img/clients/06.png)

![](assets/img/clients/07.png)

![](assets/img/clients/08.png)

## UN FUTURO MURAL EN 3 PASOS

Cuéntanos dónde sueñas ver un mural y trabajaremos juntos para hacerlo realidad.

![](assets/img/cards-1.jpg)

### 1\. Mide tu muro

Para planificar el diseño y los recursos.

![](assets/img/cards-2.jpg)

### 2\. Ubícalo en el mapa

Para llegar directo a tu comunidad.

![](assets/img/cards-3.jpg)

### 3\. Déjanos tu contacto

Te escribiremos para hacerlo posible.

  

¿Has visto un muro que merece ser transformado?

### ¡No lo pienses más y propónlo ahora!

[Proponer un mural](https://murales.colorizatubarrio.com/)

### ¡Únete a COLORIZA y transforma ciudades!

Convierte muros olvidados en arte, identidad y esperanza para la ciudadanía. Con tu apoyo —o el de tu organización— transformamos espacios olvidados en galerías urbanas vibrantes que inspiran y unen comunidades.

[Quiero donar](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+51991231559&text=Hola%20COLORIZA,%20%F0%9F%8E%A8%F0%9F%92%AA%F0%9F%8F%BB%F0%9F%98%80%F0%9F%96%8C%EF%B8%8F%20Quiero%20ser%20parte%20del%20proyecto%20Coloriza%20tu%20barrio%E2%80%A6%20)

## PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES

¿Tienes alguna consulta?

###  ¿Qué tipos de murales realiza COLORIZA?

Realizamos murales comunitarios, artísticos, temáticos, corporativos, educativos y patrimoniales. Cada proyecto puede co-crearse con la comunidad o ser desarrollado por artistas invitados, siempre con un enfoque de identidad, memoria y transformación social.

### ¿Cómo se eligen las propuestas?

Seleccionamos las propuestas según su viabilidad técnica, el impacto positivo en la comunidad y su alineación con nuestros objetivos de identidad, memoria y transformación social. Priorizamos espacios en zonas vulnerables y de alto valor comunitario.

### ¿Cómo puedo hacer una donación?

Puedes donar fácilmente a través de nuestros canales oficiales, eligiendo si tu aporte será en efectivo, materiales o servicios. También puedes coordinar donaciones corporativas o patrocinios contactando directamente a nuestro equipo.

### ¿Qué tipo de información debo incluir en mi propuesta?

Incluye la ubicación exacta del muro, medidas, fotografías recientes, breve descripción del espacio y su importancia para la comunidad. Si es posible, añade contactos de vecinos u organizaciones locales que respalden la iniciativa.

  

[Propón tu mural](https://murales.colorizatubarrio.com/) [Escríbenos Ahora](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+51991231559&text=Hola%20COLORIZA,%20%F0%9F%8E%A8%F0%9F%92%AA%F0%9F%8F%BB%F0%9F%98%80%F0%9F%96%8C%EF%B8%8F%20Quiero%20ser%20parte%20del%20proyecto%20Coloriza%20tu%20barrio%E2%80%A6%20)

# POLINIZA DOS 2026. XXI Trobada d'Art Urbà

## De l'11 al 15 de maig de 2026, Universitat Politècnica de València

  

La Universitat Politècnica de València, a través de l'Àrea d'Acció Cultural del Vicerectorat d'Art, Ciència, Societat i Tecnologia, presenta la 21a edició de la Trobada d'Art Urbà pol·linitzats 2026, que se celebrarà de l'11 al 15 de maig en els espais del Campus de Vera de València.

  

En aquesta edició, la Trobada proposa una reflexió entorn de l'espacialitat, amb l'objectiu d'anar més enllà del mural com a format pictòric i contribuir a la construcció d'un sentit espacial i arquitectònic. Per a això, es planteja una aproximació expandida des de la investigació artística, entesa com una eina per a la configuració d'espacialitats pròpies, carregades de sentit discursiu.

[Salute to the Sun by Patricia Piccnini @patricia.p ![Salute to the Sun by Patricia Piccnini @patricia.piccinini
Salute to the Sun continues my long fascination with the boundary we draw between the natural and the artificial — and how readily that line dissolves once you look closely. This new bronze sculpture is a chimera, seamlessly moving between deer, tree, fungus, human and motorcycle. It evolves out of a machine base into an organic form whose arms, or perhaps antlers, unfurl like budding leaves.
The pose comes from the sun salute and from the way plants quietly rotate to face the light. I love that it stands on a beach, an obvious artificial construct, yet entirely at home in that archetypical natural place. Its materiality also reflects this: Bronze is mostly copper, a metal that was laid down in the earth eons ago, but shaped entirely by the manipulation of elemental fire by human activity.
In earlier work I looked at imagining machines with the tenderness, balance and yearning of living things. These machines are the wild creatures of a world where we are all intertwined with technology. ‘Salute to the Sun’ presents a creature of modern mythology: an hybrid chimera drawing its energy from the sun, more vulnerable than threatening, asking us where we fit into this world.

description: Brunswick Music Festival is returning in 2027! Be the first to hear about lineup drops, venue takeovers, and ticket releases. Subscribe now for exclusive updates.
markdown:
Brunswick Music Festival | Melbourne's Iconic Fest Returns in 2027

Navigation

Brunswick Music Festival

Search

Brunswick Music Festival returns from **28 February to 7 March 2027**, bringing a week of live music, community celebration, and unforgettable performances to Merri-bek. Save the date and stay tuned for program announcements. [Sign up to our EDM to stay in the loop.](https://ems.gs/3bclf0kbhiXe)

Special Projects Expressions of Interest Now Open

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fqynhxqky%2Fproduction%2F2c843d972125880090cb3c4cb083d129d52c8933-5000x3333.jpg&w=2560&q=75)

Brunswick Music Festival is now accepting expressions of interest (EOIs) for special projects or events for inclusion in our 2027 Program. We want to hear your big ideas. We’re looking for exciting show concepts, venue take-overs, full concert lines ups, special music projects, the creation of new work, album releases, or other ideas that can happen only in a festival context.

Key Dates

*   Expressions of Interest Open: Monday 10 August 2026
*   Online EOI Information Session: Thursday 20 August 2026, 6:00pm to 7:00pm. [Click Here to Register](https://events.teams.microsoft.com/event/ff8e8dea-679a-4abb-8f24-7a586cdb3e11@fd1e4787-5974-4ae8-ac86-93ab2fd52107)[.](https://events.teams.microsoft.com/event/e6bb3ace-3ba7-4b04-8ffc-d5e6c63fa16e@fd1e4787-5974-4ae8-ac86-93ab2fd52107)
*   Expressions of Interest Close: 11:59 pm, Sunday 13 September 2026

[Learn More](https://merribekcitycouncil.snapforms.com.au/form/brunswick-music-festival-2027---special-projects-eoi)

**Brunswick Music Festival Welcomes New Programmer El Chantry**

![](/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fqynhxqky%2Fproduction%2F5025af6c3011b557f68ecbd9ec32d1480684bb23-1169x886.jpg&w=2560&q=75)

Merri-bek City Council is pleased to announce the appointment of El Chantry as the new Programmer for Brunswick Music Festival.

El Chantry is the Programming Manager at Melbourne Recital Centre, where she has curated the Centre's contemporary music program since 2018.

With more than 15 years' experience across music programming, festival production, partnership development and creative leadership, her career has included roles with Melbourne Music Week, Creative Partnerships Australia and Gertrude Street Projection Festival.

"As both a music programmer and a proud Brunswick resident, I have long admired Brunswick Music Festival for its ability to bring people together and genuinely celebrate the diversity of our community." -**El Chantry**

**Techno Picnic is back!** The event is scheduled for Sunday 1st November by the Molonglo River at the Waterskiing Club. Warm air, unreal sunset, dancing feet that need some practice, and a weatherproof venue on standby.

For years we threw warehouse parties. Late and loud with ridiculous artists. Techno Picnic has the same soul with decorum: earlier, cheaper, a bit more ‘picnic’.

## The Music

Headlining is **D-Nox** with a FOUR-HOUR set. For anyone unfamiliar, D-Nox has been a global mainstay of melodic and progressive techno for decades. Driving beats, rolling basslines, and emotional builds that sneak up and get you when you least expect it. Plenty of you remember 2019, when he turned Verity Lane into a big trampoline. It’s an honour to have him back, now with grass and frisbees.

Playing beforehand is **Waxlily** — an Escape Ferocity warehouse resident who’s been away charming Sydney, now coming home to sprinkle that sparkly energy and seamless mixing across the afternoon. Lunch has never sounded so good.

## The Vibe

Same ethos: a tip-top international artist without the heavy ticket price, and open to all ages.

## The Key Bits

*   Sunday 1 November, 1–7pm, by the water. Home in time to look responsible.
*   Bring your mates or the cute little ratbags.
*   Bring a blanket, snacks and an esky of (any) drinks, or let the bar and food stalls handle it.
*   Micaela’s cocktails, local wines and delicious food.
*   Merch: picnic blankets and competition-weight frisbees.

Questions? Email [connect@technopicnic.com](mailto:connect@technopicnic.com) .

# **Blazing Swan 2027: Side Quest**  
**(24th – 30th March 2027, Jilakin Rock City, Kulin)**

## **Tickets for Swan 2027 are expected to be released in mid-to-late November 2026**

## **Volunteering for Blazing Swan 2027 event is expected to open in early to mid-November 2026**

Please stay tuned to our website and social media for updates

Life rarely follows the path imagined. We discover new avenues, change direction and sometimes get a little lost.

But so often, when we arrive, we find the people, places and pieces of ourselves quietly waiting for us to arrive.

Thirteen detours and somehow you land exactly where you needed to be.

Sometimes, the best parts of a journey are the ones you never planned.

Sometimes, it’s about the journey rather than the end destination.

Blazing Swan 2027: “Side Quest” invites you to embrace the adventure, wander without a destination and find a familiar soul in an unfamiliar face. To deviate to find undiscovered art, or wander into the camp you hadn’t planned to visit. To immerse yourself in creativity, participate, play and perhaps…. say “YES” a little more often.

We encourage you to live our 11 Principles. To embrace your curiosity, release your self-expressions, share your gifts and pick up some MOOP along the way as you get wonderfully lost amongst the community. Meet friends you don’t know yet, welcome the stranger into your adventures, and stay up just long enough to welcome a sunrise.

Nothing planned, but something wholesome, unplanned and magical experienced.

Between the dust, dancing, creating, gifting and the people we meet along the way, you might find yourself wondering…

Is Blaze the Side Quest? Or is everyday life simply the Side Quest that brings us home to the paddock, one more time?

Every path leads somewhere, but when the Side Quest becomes part of our story that matters most….it transforms into the ultimate adventure

**Blazing Swan 2027**  
**Side Quest**  
**_~Take the Scenic Route_**

![](https://blazingswan.com.au/wp-content/uploads/BLAZE-ART-27-scaled.jpg)

The Blazing Swan annual event is dedicated to RADICAL SELF-EXPRESSION and RADICAL SELF-RELIANCE for seven days of community over the Easter Long Weekend, from Wednesday 24th 2027 (noon) to Tuesday 30th March 2027 (noon).

Blazing Swan is an official Burning Man Regional Event. We practice DECOMMODIFICATION, placing ourselves and our relationships at the centre of our own lives, GIVING and receiving openly, being IMMEDIATELY present, and acknowledging that everything we have ever accomplished, everything we will ever accomplish, only happens through COMMUNAL EFFORT. We will be RADICALLY EXPRESSIVE and RADICALLY INCLUSIVE and ask only of ourselves and others that we respect and value each other and practice kindness and caring.

Blazing Swan is not a spectator event. Every participant is a performer, every act is a performance. Find your best self, your creative self, and play it out on the stage that is Blazing Swan.

Blazing Swan gives absolute priority to CONSENT, CIVIC RESPONSIBILITY and LEAVING NO TRACE. When you purchase a ticket you sign-up to say you understand what all these things mean, and you will follow our rules which are there to keep everyone safe. People do ask, “Why do you have so many rules? More than any other event I’ve ever been to!” It’s because we care. And a week in the Australian outback is not a naturally safe space. Be prepared.

Read the Ticket FAQ and the Event FAQ on the Website, read the Survival Guide, read about the Principles and our Statement of Inclusion. Get your head around our Blazing Swan Tickets and Event Attendance Terms and Conditions. PARTICIPATION and CIVIC RESPONSIBILITY starts here.

We acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land where our event is held – the Njaki Njaki, Ballardong, and Wiilman Noongar peoples and their Elders past and present. We acknowledge and respect their continuing Culture and the contribution they make to the life of this country and region.

Much more information about Blazing Swan, our culture, our people and our art can be found on this website.

## ULUWATU SINGLE FIN CLASSIC 17-18 August 2024

As one of Bali’s most prestigious events, this year’s Uluwatu Single Fin Classic promises to be the best yet. World champions Mark Occhilupo, Joel Parkinson, Mikey February, Joel Tudor, and Tosh Tudor, along with iconic Indonesian surfers, will join the lineup.  
  
The Single Fin Classic celebrates the history and iconic visuals that put Uluwatu on the surfing map in 1972. All boards must be original pre-1990s designs, reflecting the era when single fin surfboards were the only choice.  
  
SFC kicks off on Friday, August 16, with a panel talk featuring Occy, Parko, Mike February, Joel, and Tosh Tudor. Daily live music will play from noon until late. With a favorable long-range forecast, this year’s Uluwatu Single Fin Classic promises an exciting weekend for all Bali lovers.

## ![ABOUT](common/images/main_title_about.png)

### GO OUT CAMP/GO OUT JAMBOREEとは

全国のキャンプ場を舞台に、ヒト、モノ、そして文化と自然との出会いや発見、都会では味わえない経験ができる  
アウトドアキャンプフェスティバル。

![GOOUT](common/images/main_about_ph.png)

ファッション・アウトドア・ライフスタイルを提案する雑誌「GO OUT」が誌面から飛び出しキャンプ場という自然のど真ん中で、新しい仲間との出会いや、自然の強さと優しさを体感できる時間、様々なアイテムやアクティビティの体験をパッケージしたアウトドアフェスティバル。会場には人気アーティストのライブ、来場者による色とりどりのテント、人気ブランドの特別ブース、ボルダリング、スラックライン、キッズフィールドなどのアクティビティ、各地元の名産物が揃い、どこにもない特別な野外空間となっている。音楽、ショッピング、アクティビティ、ワークショップなど様々な遊びとともに、子どもから大人まで、自由な時間を過ごすことができる場所、それがGO OUT CAMP／JAMBOREEです。

**見つかるのは、****服だけじゃない。** 古着フェス®は、全国の古着店や個性あふれる出店者が一堂に集う、国内最大級の古着の祭典。お気に入りを探す時間も、偶然の出会いも、誰かの戦利品に心が動く瞬間も。ここには、画面だけでは出会えない体験があります。 [チケットを見る →](https://furugi-fes.com/#ticket) 前回実績 300 全国から集まるショップ ヴィンテージ／アメカジ／Y2K／レディース SINCE 2017FURUGI FESTIVAL® 01 ### はじめての古着フェス。 まずは会場を歩くだけで大丈夫。たくさんのラックが、あなたの「好き」の入口になります。 CHECKED / 歩 02 ### 友だちと、デートで。 一着を選ぶ時間も、戦利品を見せ合う時間も。目的地にするから、一日がもっと楽しくなる。 CHECKED / 選 03 ### 本気で、掘る。 ラックの間も、山積みのボックスも。偶然の出会いまで、全部が古着フェスの醍醐味です。 CHECKED / 掘 HOW WILL YOU DIG? * 初めてなら、会場を歩く。 * ふたりなら、戦利品を見せ合う。 * 本気なら、目当てを掘り当てる。 Dig Deeper ![色とりどりの古着が並ぶラックから一着を選ぶ来場者](images/rack.webp) ### まず、目で掘る。 RACK 024 ![東京ビッグサイトの広い会場に端から端まで並ぶ古着ブース](images/wide-hall.webp) ### 端から端まで、全部ラック。 FIELD NOTE ![段ボール箱に積まれた古着を掘る来場者](images/dig.webp) ### 掘って、見つけて、連れて帰る。 One of One 同じ一着は、二度と出てこない。 ONE OF ONE✦2026.11.15 SUN✦TOKYO BIG SIGHT✦ ONE OF ONE✦2026.11.15 SUN✦TOKYO BIG SIGHT✦ Atmosphere This is what it looks like. ## **会場の空気は、****こんな感じ。** 東京ビッグサイトのホールいっぱいに、全国の古着屋のラックと山積みの古着。歩いて、めくって、掘る。その一日の様子です。 ![会場に集まった来場者の人だかり](images/gallery/g01.webp) ![ラグや雑貨を並べたブース](images/gallery/g02.webp) ![ラックの列と通路を行き交う来場者](images/gallery/g03.webp) ![古着ブースが並ぶ会場の賑わい](images/gallery/g04.webp) ![デニムを並べたブースを見る来場者](images/gallery/g05.webp) ![ラックを見て回る来場者たち](images/gallery/g06.webp) ![色とりどりの古着が並ぶラック](images/gallery/g07.webp) ![古着を吊るした出店ブース](images/gallery/g08.webp) ![会場内のキッチンカーと休憩する来場者](images/gallery/g09.webp) ![ラックの間で古着を選ぶ来場者](images/gallery/g10.webp) ![WEGO VINTAGE のブースで古着を選ぶ来場者](images/gallery/g11.webp) ![東京ビッグサイトの会場を埋める古着ブース（俯瞰）](images/gallery/g12.webp) 写真は2024年6月開催時の様子です。出店内容・会場構成は今回と異なる場合があります。 Shops Find your shop. ## **どちらの_入り方_で、****掘りにいく？** 気軽に楽しむなら **一般前売券** 本気で掘るなら **先行入場券** MOST POPULAR General / Advance ### 一般前売券 **¥500**TAX IN 券面価格が当日券より ¥200 安い * 10:00 入場／19:00 まで（最終入場 18:30） * 10:00から19:00まで、まるごと一日 * 小学生以下は無料で同伴できます ADMIT ONE11.15 SUN [この券を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_general_price&lp_ref=rmvh74v8j1gcfnk&click_ref=cmvh74v8knceudw) Early Entry ### 先行入場前売券 9:00 **¥1,000**TAX IN * 一般入場より1時間早く入れる * 目当ての店から順に回れる * 前回770名が選んだ入り方 EARLY 9:0011.15 SUN [この券を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021001?cta_placement=ticket_early_section&lp_ref=rmvh74v8j1gcfnk&click_ref=cmvh74v8k6j4oqs) 2名分 Pair / Advance ### 前売ペアチケット **¥900**2名 / TAX IN 1名あたり ¥450 * 2名で入場できます（10:00 入場） * 一般前売券を2枚買うより券面価格が安い * 当日ペアチケットは ¥1,200（1名あたり ¥600） * 購入画面の「席種」で**前売ペアチケット**を選んでください（〈10時入場〉の受付内） ADMIT TWO11.15 SUN [この券を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_pair_section&lp_ref=rmvh74v8j1gcfnk&click_ref=cmvh74v8kdd7apt) * 前回 約300店舗 * 東京ビッグサイト * 2026.11.15 SUN * 小学生以下 無料 イープラスでの買い方（3ステップ） 1. **券種のボタンを押す**「9時先行入場」と「10時入場」は、イープラス上で別の受付です。買いたい方のボタンから進んでください。 2. **「次へ」→ 枚数と「席種」を選ぶ**10時入場の受付では、「席種」のプルダウンで _入場券 ¥500_ か _ペアチケット ¥900_ を選びます。 3. **イープラスにログインして購入**スマチケ（電子チケット）で発券手数料は 0円。会員登録が必要です。 公演日時2026/11/15(日) 10:00開演 ▾ 席種選択して下さい ▾ * 選択して下さい * 入場券 ¥500 * ペアチケット ¥900 枚数— ▾ 購入画面のイメージ。ここでペアチケットを選べます。 ※ 表示価格はチケット代（税込）です。**別途、販売サイト所定のシステム利用料・ 発券手数料等がかかる場合があります。**お支払い総額は購入画面でご確認ください。 ※ 掲載写真は過去開催時の様子です。出店内容・会場構成は今回と異なる場合があります。 Next Event Mark your calendar. ## **はじめての****_古着フェス。_** 気になる古着がある人も、何を選べばいいか分からない人も。必要なのは、少しの好奇心だけです。 01 ### 前売券を買っておく 券面価格が当日券より200円安く設定されています。朝から回るなら、9時入場の先行入場券を。 02 ### 11.15 を予定に入れる 会場は東京ビッグサイト。広い会場を歩ける準備で、じっくり探しましょう。 03 ### 公式Instagramをフォロー 出店者・会場の続報は、公式発信で確認できます。 04 ### 見つけたら、迷わず手に取る 一期一会の古着は、次のラックには残っていないかもしれません。 The Feeling ## **「これだ」が、****あちこちにある。** 通り過ぎるだけの服はない。手に取った時から、その服の次の物語が始まる。 ![古着のラックが続く通路を歩く来場者](images/community.webp) ![山積みの古着から一着を選ぶ来場者たち](images/blue-balloons.webp) FAQ ## **よくある質問** 前売券はどこで購入できますか？ 販売開始後は、本ページの購入ボタンからイープラスの販売ページへ進んでください。販売開始日は決定次第、本ページと公式Instagramでお知らせします。 先行入場券と一般前売券の違いは何ですか？ 先行入場券は9:00から、一般前売券は10:00から入場いただけます。先行入場券は一般入場より1時間早く会場に入れる券です。 小学生以下は入場できますか？ 小学生以下のお子さまは無料でご入場いただけます。保護者の方とご一緒にお越しください。 支払い方法は何が使えますか？ 会場での支払い方法は出店者によって異なります。現金のご用意をおすすめします。 試着はできますか？ 出店者によって対応が異なります。詳細は当日、各ブースでご確認ください。 会場での撮影について 当日は広報活動の一環として会場内を撮影し、Webサイト・SNS・印刷物などに掲載する場合があります。ご来場・ご出店の皆様が撮影対象となることがありますので、あらかじめご了承ください。 再入場はできますか？ できます。入場時にお渡しするリストバンドをご提示ください。 どのくらい時間がかかりますか？ 会場規模と出店数は確定後にお知らせします。前回規模では、じっくり回る場合は半日ほどみておくと安心です。 ペットを連れて行けますか？ ペットの同伴はご遠慮いただいております。 ![ラックの間を埋める古着フェスの来場者](images/crowd.webp) ![](images/logo.webp) 2026.11.15 — TOKYO BIG SIGHT ## **次の掘る日を、****押さえておこう。** 前売券は券面価格が当日券より200円安く設定されています。 朝から本気で探すなら、9時入場の先行入場券を。 [前売券500円を購入する](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_general_final&lp_ref=rmvh74v8j1gcfnk&click_ref=cmvh74v8k7ho09h) [公式で続報を拾う ↗](https://www.instagram.com/furugi_festival/) * 前回 約300店舗 * 東京ビッグサイト * 11.15 SUN Official Partners ![一般社団法人AND BUYER](images/organizer-andbuyer.webp) ORGANIZER ![ZOZOUSED](images/kv/logo-zozoused.svg) 協賛 / SPONSOR FURUGI FESTIVAL® / PRESENTED BY AND BUYER — [公式サイト](https://andbuyer.or.jp/furugifestival/) / [@furugi\_festival](https://www.instagram.com/furugi_festival/) / [アクセス解析について](https://furugi-fes.com/privacy) 掲載の開催情報は、公式発表に基づき更新します。古着フェス® は一般社団法人AND BUYERの登録商標です。 [10:00 ENTRY**¥500**](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021002?cta_placement=ticket_general_sticky&lp_ref=rmvh74v8j1gcfnk&click_ref=cmvh74v8kqsqfqm) [9:00 ENTRY**¥1,000**](https://eplus.jp/sf/detail/4600450001-P0030001P021001?cta_placement=ticket_early_sticky&lp_ref=rmvh74v8j1gcfnk&click_ref=cmvh74v8k2ysvht)

Antal

AntalのDJプレイを一度でも目にしたことがあるなら、彼がロータリーミキサーに注ぐエネルギーの凄まじさを知っているだろう。彼は空間の呼吸を感じ取り、その瞬間に必要な音を届ける術を心得ている。卓越したDJであることに加え、彼は起業家であり、キュレーターであり、さらにはフットボールコーチでもある。そしてもちろん、アムステルダムの名門レーベル〈Rush Hour Records〉の共同創設者だ。 「ギグの準備には3時間から6時間を費やす」と彼はかつてRAに語っている。膨大で多様なレコードコレクションは、彼の幅広い音楽的嗜好を物語る。シカゴやデトロイトの影響を受けたハウスから、世界の片隅で眠っていたアフロファンク、忘れ去られたディスコやブギーの名曲まで——どんなジャンルも彼の手にかかれば、ひとつのストーリーとなってフロアを照らす。 だが、その幅広さは意図的なものではない。彼にとっては、ごく自然な表現のかたちなのだ。 「最高の夜は、選曲がどれほど鋭くても、“何でもプレイできる”と感じられる時だ」と彼は言う。Antalの真骨頂は、まさにこの選曲力にある。彼はあなたが知らないトラックで踊らせる。なぜなら、いつ、どのように投下すべきかを正確に知っているからだ。そして彼は、あなたの人生に必要だと気づいていなかった曲を、そっと差し出してくる。2014年、Lowlands FestivalでのHuneeとの共演は、まさに魔法のような瞬間だった。そこからAntalの活動は一気に加速し、オスロからシンガポール、東京からサンフランシスコまで、世界中のダンスフロアへと広がっていった。彼の存在は、良質な音楽の力を信じるグローバル・コミュニティを形づくっている。その基盤は年々強固になり、今も進化を続けている。 1997年に設立された〈Rush Hour Records〉は、彼と仲間たちによるアムステルダムの音楽拠点だ。信頼できる流通部門、愛されるレコードショップ、そして世界中を巡って掘り集めたビニール盤。そのすべてがこのレーベルを支えている。Rush Hourは、最先端のハウスやテクノをリリースしながら、忘れられた名盤を再発し、過去と現在、そして未来をつなぐ架け橋となってきた。 そしてAntal自身もまた、DJとしてその使命を果たし続けている。彼のプレイは、音楽の歴史を敬いながら、常に次の瞬間へと進もうとする——まるで針が新たなグルーヴを刻むように。

[Rainbow Disco Club](https://soundcloud.com/rainbowdiscoclub "Rainbow Disco Club") · [RDC 086 - Antal at Rainbow Disco Club 2026](https://soundcloud.com/rainbowdiscoclub/rdc-086-antal "RDC 086 - Antal at Rainbow Disco Club 2026")

Hunee

HuneeのDJプレイを目にした瞬間、彼がダンスフロアと深く結ばれていることを誰もが感じ取るだろう。彼はブースの向こう側にいる人々と音楽を分かち合い、祝福し、時間と場所の境界を超えて観客を音の旅へと導く。彼のセットは常に探求のエネルギーに満ち、それぞれが独自の生命を宿した存在として呼吸し、進化し続ける。 西ドイツの旧工業都市ボーフムで、韓国出身の文化活動家の両親のもとに生まれ育ったHuneeは、学校を卒業してわずか3日後にベルリンへと移り住む。学業と並行してレコードショップで働きながら、膨大な時間を掘り出し物のレコード探索に費やし、盛り上がりを見せていたクラブシーンの中で自身のDJスタイルを確立していった。彼のプレイスタイルを支えるのは、あらゆる時代・地域の音楽を恐れることなく紡ぐ無限の好奇心だ。親密な地下室でのオールナイトプレイでも、巨大フェスティバルのクロージングでも、Huneeのセットは常に情感と高揚に満ち、聴く者を色彩豊かな体験へと引き込む。 レーベル兼プラットフォーム〈Lifetones〉は、そんなHuneeの音楽的ビジョンを具現化するコミュニティ志向のプロジェクトである。〈Rush Hour〉〈W.T.〉〈Future Times〉といった名門レーベルからのリリースは、彼の多彩なインスピレーションと独自の感性を映し出し、そのどれもがカラフルな個性を放っている。Huneeのレコードには、常に独特のファンクネス、真のソウル感覚、そしてハウス・ミュージックの精神が息づいている。それこそが、彼の音楽が世界中のダンスフロアで愛され続ける理由であり、最高峰のDJたちと肩を並べる所以である。

# Ticket Info

## Menu

Tickets to Meredith 34 are now sold out. I’m sorry if you missed out.

If you would like to, you can [join Aunty’s Waitlist](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/buying-or-selling-your-ticket/).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/MMF2025_MichaelRidley-HiRes-154-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

Each year the majority of tickets to Meredith are available via the [Subscriber Ticket Ballot](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/the-ballot/).

After the Ballot is done and dusted, there are [Online Sales](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/online-sales/).

The menu on this page has further information on All Topics Ticketing

Tickets purchased Online or in the Ballot are posted out from around mid-November. That sometimes results in a few more tickets becoming available via [Aunty’s Ticket Resale Service](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/buying-or-selling-your-ticket/).

Tickets are in the form of wristbands once again this year. There is only one type of ticket which gets you in Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

Every ticket helps regional organisations do great things in the district.

A small amount of tickets are made available each year via [Aunty’s Last Chance](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/auntys-last-chance/) – applications are open for a very short time.

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/Meredith_2025_EloiseCoomber-302-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

# The Ballot

## Menu

### The Meredith 34 Ticket Ballot has closed for this year

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/GoldenPlains2026-ChipMooney-78-1200x801.jpg?x16298)

The Subscriber Ticket Ballot for Meredith 34 has now closed.

There are two rounds of the Ballot; one around mid-August, and another a week later. You only have to enter once. The First Round is available only to existing Subscribers; the Second Round is open to new Subscribers as well as existing Subscribers.

Any Subscribers not drawn in the First Round are automatically entered into the Second Round Ballot.

If you have a Meredith Key and wish to purchase tickets during the Ballot, please visit the [Supernatural Ticket Centre](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/07/GP2025_72DPI_EloiseCoomber-50-1-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

### More About The Ballot

The Subscriber Ticket Ballot has been used since 2007 to get tickets into the hands of subscribers in an equitable and stress-free manner. The Ballot is simple, fair and efficient. It’s done online and via email.

These are the steps to take:  
  
1\. Enter the Ballot before it closes.  
  
2\. You will be notified via email by Aunty Meredith if you were or were not drawn in the Ballot. Two rounds of offers will be made.  
  
3\. If drawn in the Ballot, you will be emailed a unique alpha-numeric code (a _Meredith Key_), which you can use to make your purchase within our secure Supernatural Ticket Centre during a 5 or 6 day period, or until the Ballot Allocation runs out (which is [unlikely but statistically possible](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/unlikely-but-statistically-possible/)). You may purchase up to 3 tickets (Visa & Mastercard only), which will then be sent out to you at a later date.

If you are not drawn in the Ballot, do not despair, as there are two further allocations of tickets to go on sale.

### The Ballot Entry Process

Once Ballot entries close, all entries go into a ballot pool, from which a number are randomly drawn until the allocation is exhausted.

If you are drawn in the Ballot, you will be emailed a Meredith Key, which you can then use in the Supernatural Ticket Centre to secure your tickets. No rush. No fuss. No stress. No competing with the rest of Australia for tickets. Each Meredith Key can only be used once.

Subscribers who enter the Ballot will know whether or not they have been drawn before later allocations go on sale.

If you are a longterm subscriber and have [recently changed your email address](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/subscriber-info/), please [advise Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au?subject=Please%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address&body=Hi%20Aunty%2C%0D%0A%0D%0APlease%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20to%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AMy%20old%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20is%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AThank%20you!) so that your Ballot history is maintained.

# Ticket Dates

## Menu

Tickets to Meredith 34 are now sold out. I’m sorry if you missed out.

If you would like to, you can [join Aunty’s Waitlist](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/buying-or-selling-your-ticket/).

* * *

The majority of tickets to Meredith 34 will be available via the [Subscriber Ticket Ballot](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/the-ballot/).

There are two rounds (draws) of the Ballot. The First Round is available only to existing Subscribers; the Second Round is open to new Subscribers as well as existing Subscribers.

After the Ballot is done and dusted, there are [Online Sales](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/online-sales/), then [Aunty’s Last Chance](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/auntys-last-chance/).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/Meredith2025-ChipMooney-2-19-1200x801.jpg?x16298)

## **The Ballot**

If you are already a Meredith Subscriber, enter the Ballot before 10:34pm on Monday 10 August.

If you are not a Subscriber, enter the Ballot before 10:34pm on Tuesday 18 August to become one and enter the Ballot. It’s free and easy.

If you are a longterm subscriber and have recently changed your email address, please [follow these instructions](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/subscriber-info/) so that your history is maintained. It’s important that your ballot history is consolidated and stored on one primary subscriber account.

## **Ballot Results**

There are two rounds of the Ballot; one around mid-August, and another a week later. You only have to enter once. Any Subscribers not drawn in the first round are automatically entered into the second round Ballot.

## **Online Sales**

Open to all comers on Thursday 27 August from 11am.

## **Aunty’s Last Chance**

Designed for long-time Meredith-goers, this allocation opens after Online Sales finish.

# Online Sales

## Menu

Tickets to Meredith 34 are now sold out. I’m sorry if you missed out.

If you would like to, you can [join Aunty’s Waitlist](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/buying-or-selling-your-ticket/).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/Meredith2025-ChipMooney-2-102-1200x801.jpg?x16298)

Online Sales happen each year after the Ballot is done, open to all comers. 

This year they took place on Thursday 27 August at 11am AEST.

You need to be logged into your [Supernatural Ticket Centre](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/) account prior to 11am on the day. Please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) if you run into any difficulties setting up your account.

You do not need to have a Meredith Key code to purchase online on this day. A limit of 3 tickets per customer is in place.

Please be aware that there are limited tickets available.

Please note you need to be 18 years of age to attend Meredith; anyone under 18 must be accompanied by a [Legal Guardian](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/legal-guardian/).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/07/GP2025_BronPeters_LowRes_164-1-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

### Here’s some FAQs about Online Sales

Q. How many can we buy?  
A. Up to 3 tickets per person.

Q. Do I need a Meredith Key code to buy tickets on this day?  
A. No, you do not need a Meredith Key code to buy tickets during Online Sales.

Q. How long do we have to complete our transaction in the Online Allocation?  
A. You will have 8 minutes to complete your transaction. (_Note:_ this 8 minute window does not apply to sales in the Ballot. Ballot winners have around 5 or 6 days to make their transaction).

Q. How long will the Online Allocation take to sell out?  
A. Not long, judging on previous years.

Q. If I purchase, when are tickets sent out to me?  
A. Around mid-November.

Q. Do I need to provide names for the tickets?  
A. No.

# Price

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/07/MMF2023_ChipMooney_72-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

The ticket price for Meredith 34 is $541 (inclusive of booking fee).

The ticket price includes all camping and parking, and gives you access to the full three days and two nights of Meredith.

Only one type of ticket is sold to Meredith and it gets you Friday, Saturday and Sunday at the event. Gates open at 8am on the Friday and live music starts in the late afternoon.

Ballot and Online Tickets must be purchased using either Visa or Mastercard.

Please note that there are no options for post-payment in the Supernatural Ticket Centre. Post-payment (or ‘after pay’) can create difficulty with debt, which is not something we wish to facilitate. If you would like to come along, but are unable (or unwilling) to fund a ticket, feel free to check out our [Volunteer program](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/every-thing/volunteers/).

We are very proud of the fact that there are still no commercial sponsors at Meredith, that it is still BYO (if you are over 18), and that the capacity will not go beyond what the Supernatural Amphitheatre can comfortably host.

# Online and Ballot Ticket FAQ

## Menu

Please have a look through the topics below. If your enquiry is not covered, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2024/07/MMF2023_ChipMooney_267-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

### Can I change my delivery address?

If you would like to edit your address details, please login to your [Supernatural Ticket Centre](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/subscriber) account. From the Account Details page, scroll down to the Delivery Name and Address heading and edit your address by clicking on the edit icon on the right and entering in your correct address. Your delivery address will be automatically updated for any orders that are yet to be posted to you.

Please note that you cannot update your address once packing and shipment has commenced in late October/early November. Please [contact Aunty Meredith](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) if you have any concerns.

### **I have a Meredith Key, where do I go to purchase my tickets?**

To purchase tickets during the Ballot, please go to [tickets.mmf.com.au](http://tickets.mmf.com.au/). If this is your first time visiting the Supernatural Ticket Centre, you’ll be required to create a new password to complete your account. (Your Subscriber details and any Ballot history remain intact). If your account activation email doesn’t reach you, please [contact Aunty Meredith](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au).

### Where are my tickets?

Tickets purchased online are posted from mid-November. If you have only received one confirmation email, your order has not been sent yet.

When your order has been shipped out you will receive an email including your Australia Post Tracking ID. You can submit that number into the field on [auspost.com.au/track](http://www.auspost.com.au/track/). The scans will show you the whereabouts of your tickets. If you cannot see any scans within 7 days from receiving the ‘Your order has been shipped’ email, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) so we can help track your order.

### I lost or didn’t get my confirmation email

To check your order, please log in to your [Supernatural Ticket Centre](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/subscriber) account. Click on Order History from the menu, then click on the arrow in the Actions column. From here you can confirm your order details and download your receipt if required.

### I can’t go anymore! Can I re-sell my tickets?

In 2013 we introduced Aunty’s Ticket Resale Service to provide legitimate sellers and buyers with a trustworthy and reliable way of putting tickets in the hands of those who are keen to attend. It also helps prevent scammers from selling tickets at inflated prices via unauthorised means. Aunty’s Resale Service is the only authorised resale facility. Don’t let your tickets get into the hands of [Dickheads](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/dickhead-policy/). The resale service comes into effect once tickets have sold out and closes 14 days before the festival.

If you purchase tickets to Meredith and your circumstances change and you can no longer attend, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au). If we can re-sell your tickets via Aunty’s Waitlist, we will arrange a reverse charge of your ticket/s. Please note we are unable to refund your booking fee. Where the tickets have already been posted to you there is a $5 resale processing fee per ticket. Note that this is not a refund service, as tickets are non-refundable, which means in the event that there are insufficient people on Aunty’s Waitlist, you will not be able to return your ticket/s. [Read full details about Aunty’s Ticket Resale Service](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/buying-or-selling-your-ticket/).

Meredith is subject to a major event ticketing declaration under Part 9A of the Major Events Act 2009. This means it is an offence to sell, advertise or offer to resell a ticket for more than 10% above its face value purchase price. Offenders face fines of between $1,018 and $610,530 depending on the nature of the offence.

Please don’t let a ticket get into the hands of a [Dickhead](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/dickhead-policy/).

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2014/07/CW2A9170.jpg?x16298)

### Can I get my tickets posted to an overseas address?

We can only post tickets within Australia. If you currently reside overseas, it is preferable that you enter a shipping address of a friend or relative who is based in Australia. If this is an issue, please [contact Aunty Meredith](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au).

### There are multiple charges on my credit card!

If you are looking at your online statement, it possibly says “temporary authorisation” or “pending” next to one of the charges. This is your bank putting a hold on the funds. They usually automatically clear the hold within 24-72 hours.

If you are sure your purchase did go through and you believe you were charged too much, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) and we can investigate.

### Can I send my Meredith Key to someone else to use?

A Meredith Key is only valid for one use. If you are successful in the Ballot and choose not to use your Key, you can certainly pass it on to a friend to use.

### When will my tickets be sent to me?

Meredith tickets purchased online are posted from around mid-November – this is to reduce the likelihood of them being lost or stolen, and as an anti-scalping measure. You will receive a ‘Your order has been shipped’ email when they have been posted.

### **Can I pay for my tickets via Paypal or a post-payment service?**

This year, the payment options for Ballot and Online Sales are Visa and Mastercard. Paypal has previously been offered as a payment option for Meredith and Golden Plains tickets, but this is no longer the case.

Likewise, there are no options for post-payment (or ‘after pay’), as it can create difficulty with debt, which is not something we wish to facilitate.

### How much are the tickets?

The ticket price for Meredith 34 is $541 (inclusive of booking fee).

There is only one type of ticket sold to Meredith and it gets you in from 8am Friday right through to The End at 4:30pm Sunday. Camping and parking are included.

### Aunty’s Last Chance

Aunty’s Last Chance is a small allocation of tickets set aside for long-time Meredith goers who didn’t score in the Ballot and Online allocations. Applications open after Online Sales finish.

For more details go to [Aunty’s Last Chance](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/auntys-last-chance/).

### Do I need a ticket or a wristband?

Tickets are in the form of wristbands. A ticket is a wristband; a wristband is a ticket. You only need the wristband to gain entry – it is your ticket.

No additional wristband or ticket is required – just that one.

# I Wasn’t Drawn in the Ballot

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/MMF2025_MichaelRidley-HiRes-142-1-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

Hello. Here you will find an explanation of how the Ballot works.

Firstly, please be aware that a large number of people who enter the Ballot are not drawn in either round. And that not being drawn in the Ballot does NOT mean that you can’t go to Meredith.

In fact, the number of people who are at Meredith (that is, at The Sup’) every year who are _not_ personally drawn in the Ballot is greater than the number that are. 

The ticketing system has been designed and implemented over many years with as much fairness as possible. There are far more people who want to go to Meredith than there are tickets available, so the system attempts to make sense of that equation as best it can.

The Ticketing System allows ticket-seekers at least four bites at the cherry, using different methods, at different times. Speed of internet is not a factor. How long you’ve been going is a factor in two of the four allocations. New people are welcome, as they always have been. It’s as fair as it can be, when there are many more people than there are tickets.

The Ballot is just the first allocation of tickets. After the two rounds of the Ballot there are [Online Sales](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/online-sales/), then lastly there’s [Aunty’s Last Chance](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/auntys-last-chance/), which is based as far as possible ‘on merit’ and looks after those who have been Subscribers the longest first.

Each Ballot winner can purchase three tickets. Many people who win the Ballot have friends who also entered the Ballot and so they can look after them with their ‘second’ and ‘third’ ticket. So the Ballot ‘looks after’ three times more people than just the ‘Ballot winners’ – in practice there are three times more ‘Ballot winners’ than it seems at first. If we instead only allowed one ticket purchase per Ballot winner, there would be three times as many winners. However, that is not a practical solution; it would split up groups of friends and couples and would mean extra postage fees for every single purchaser.

The actual Ballot process is indeed random. But the length of time someone has been a Subscriber is taken into consideration. The First Round is only for existing Subscribers, and though it doesn’t guarantee anybody tickets – nobody has ever been guaranteed tickets to Meredith – it does favour those who have been attending the longest.

Within that First Round draw, the year in which a Subscriber subscribed is taken into account. Sometimes anomalies happen whereby longer-term Subscribers don’t score and newer ones do. That is the nature of being random. It does favour the longer-term Subscribers, but it’s not an absolute certainty.

If you are a longterm Subscriber and have recently changed your email address, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au?subject=Please%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address&body=Hi%20Aunty%2C%0D%0A%0D%0APlease%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20to%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AMy%20old%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20is%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AThank%20you!) to [update your Subscriber details](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/every-thing/subscriber-info/) – as it’s important that your Ballot history is consolidated and stored on one primary Subscriber account.

[Let me know](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) if you’d like further explanation.

I fully realise not being drawn in the Ballot – even though it’s random – seems like a rejection, but please don’t take it personally. For what it’s worth, issuing ‘sorry you didn’t win the ballot’ emails is the worst task of my whole year and I dread that August day for months.

The ticketing system has been designed and implemented with as much fairness as possible. There are four bites at the cherry, using different methods, at different times. Speed of internet is not a factor. How long you’ve been going is a factor. New people are welcome. It’s as fair as it can be, when there are way more people than there are tickets. You can read further details about each aspect of the [ticketing system](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/).

Sincerely,

![Aunty](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/themes/msa-mmf-2026/images/signature.svg)

# Buying or Selling Your Ticket

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/GP2026_MarcelleBradbeer_145-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

In 2013 we introduced Aunty’s Ticket Resale Service to provide legitimate sellers and buyers with a trustworthy and reliable way of putting tickets in the hands of those who are keen to attend. It also helps prevent scammers from selling tickets at inflated prices via unauthorised means. Aunty’s Resale Service is the only authorised resale facility. Don’t let your tickets get into the hands of [Dickheads](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/dickhead-policy/). The resale service comes into effect once tickets have sold out and closes 14 days before the festival.

Note that this is not a refund service, as tickets are non-refundable, which means in the event that there are insufficient people on Aunty’s Waitlist, you will not be able to return your ticket/s.

## Offering a Ticket?

Tickets to Meredith are non-refundable. However, if you have spare tickets or your circumstances change and you can no longer attend, you may be able to exchange your ticket/s via Aunty’s Resale Service, which opens if/when tickets sell out and there are sufficient people on Aunty’s Waitlist.

Please note that we are unable to refund your booking fee for tickets exchanged through the Resale Service. If we have begun packing tickets, or your tickets have already been posted, there is also a $5 resale processing fee per ticket. In the event that there are insufficient people on Aunty’s Waitlist, you will not be able to return your ticket/s.

Aunty’s Ticket Resale Service closes 14 days prior to the festival weekend.

## Wanting a ticket?

Applications to join Aunty’s Waitlist have opened for this year.

   [Join Aunty’s Waitlist](https://subscribe.mmf.com.au/waitlist)   

Please keep in mind that you need to be a current [Subscriber](http://subscribe.mmf.com.au/) and you are able to apply for up to two tickets.

If any tickets are returned, Aunty will contact people on the Waitlist and check that they are still looking for a ticket. Assuming this is the case, the new buyer will be given a code and 48 hours to make their purchase. Your tickets will then be posted out in November.

## How does the Resale Service work?

Once the Resale Service opens (ie. when the festival has sold out) and there are people on Aunty’s Waitlist looking for a spare, we can arrange a reverse charge of your transaction. Please note that your booking fee ($12 per ticket) will not be refunded. The refund will go back to the card used for the original purchase. Please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au?subject=Aunty's%20Ticket%20Resale%20Service) if you’re keen to use the service, outlining the number of tickets in your order that you no longer require.

When emailing Aunty, the purchaser is required to use the same email that was used for the purchase.

**Important:** If someone else purchased your ticket via the Supernatural Ticket Centre, you will need to ask the original purchaser to contact Aunty to advise that one of their tickets is no longer required.

Periodic offers will be made to people on Aunty’s Waitlist as spare tickets are returned.

## Why does the Resale Service Close?

Aunty’s Resale Service closes two weeks prior to the weekend. As tickets to Meredith and Golden Plains are hard-copy tickets (wristbands), it’s a sometimes complicated process to get tickets into the hands of buyers on the waitlist once tickets have been posted out. Without that two week period, tickets wouldn’t arrive in time.

In 2025 the Resale Service was open for 3 months and we assisted hundreds of people whose plans had changed to re-home their tickets.

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/Meredith2025-ChipMooney-2-67-1200x801.jpg?x16298)

## **Please Be Warned**

We have introduced this service due to the dramatic rise in the number of people who were being scammed using unauthorised resale methods. If you are considering buying a ticket from someone on Facebook, Reddit, eBay or Gumtree (or the like), please be very careful and approach any transactions with extreme caution. The safest option is always to buy your ticket directly from us – either via [The Ballot](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/the-ballot/), [Online Sales](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/online-sales/) or via Aunty’s Ticket Resale Service.

**Be scammer savvy:** Anyone offering tickets for sale online with little actual knowledge of the festival (eg. location, duration), offering ‘digital’ tickets (all tickets are wristbands), using generic terms like ‘overnight shipping’ or ‘will call’, advertising multiple tickets that were bought for ‘family members’, asking you to directly message them and/or turning off post comments, using a Facebook profile with very little or no personal information visible, or offering tickets at well below the purchase price, should be avoided. Scammers are known to create Facebook groups using festival imagery for the sole purpose of ticket resale scams – Meredith **does not** manage any Facebook groups, or verify any sellers/exchanges within those groups.

If you are buying or selling a ticket via other means, Victoria Police have introduced [Safe Buying and Selling exchange sites](https://www.police.vic.gov.au/online-marketplace-safe-exchange-sites), which may be of interest to you. If payment must be made online or via bank transfer, we do not recommend doing so until you are in possession of the ticket.

Meredith is subject to a major event ticketing declaration under Part 9A of the Major Events Act 2009. This means it is an offence to sell, advertise or offer to resell a ticket for more than 10% above its face value purchase price ($541). Offenders face fines of between $1,018 and $610,530 depending on the nature of the offence.

Ticket holders are welcome to pass on their ticket if they wish to, preferably via Aunty’s Resale Service. Alternately, if you bought a ticket and can no longer attend, you can sell your ticket to a friend, as long as you do not sell it for more than 10% above its face value purchase price. Please don’t let a ticket get into the hands of a [Dickhead](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/dickhead-policy/).

## **Look After Each Ticket in Your Order**

You are responsible for all the tickets in your order, even if they are no longer in your possession. For example, if you buy three tickets and give one to a friend of a friend and that person sells it (or attempts to sell it) for 10% more than the face value purchase price, that ticket is still associated with you on our database. You are still responsible for all the tickets in your order.

_Please note:_ Meredith Key codes (ballot codes) are strictly not for sale and any codes bought or sold will be null and void.

# Kids / All Ages

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/Meredith_CGiuffre-274-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

Meredith is an all-ages event. However, anyone under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or [Legal Guardian](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/legal-guardian/) and must carry a signed [Legal Guardian Consent Form](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2023/07/MMF-Guardian-Consent-Form.pdf?x77016) at all times. The parent or legal guardian must also have a valid wristband.

Meredith is not set up or designed with people under 18 in mind.

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/07/MER2024_Leah-Hulst-20241213_0147-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

Kids under 12 are free, kids 12 and over need a (full price) valid wristband. Kids under 12 are given a wristband on entry and their parents’ mobile phone numbers are written on them in case of emergency, eg. in case the kid gets lost. Please complete the “Register My Under 12” form for each kid under 12 who will be in your care at the festival. Proof of age may be required for kids’ tickets, so please come prepared.

[REGISTER MY UNDER 12](https://forms.gle/sYXuVmDXwimo7Mga8)

Whilst we welcome parents bringing their kids, again, we don’t set up or design [What Goes On](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/) with kids in mind; there are no dedicated kids’ activities and no childminding or creche-type facilities. So please think carefully before bringing kids; it’s a big crowd, a stage with amplified music and they’ll essentially be outdoors in country Victoria’s weather for three days. Come very prepared to look after them brilliantly and remember their skin, ears and eyes are more sensitive than yours. You are waaaay better off leaving the kids with their grandparents if you can and coming on down for some kid-like fun of your own. But you know, that’s up to you.

This information is one of our [policies](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/policies/) and forms part of our [terms and conditions](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/terms-and-conditions/).

All tickets purchased via the Ballot or Online Sales are sent out in November, even those purchased in August. Delaying their delivery to you decreases the chance of tickets being lost or stolen. It is also an anti-scalping measure.

When your order has been shipped out you will receive an email, which will include your Australia Post Tracking ID. You can submit that number into the field on [auspost.com.au/track](http://www.auspost.com.au/track/). The scans will show you the whereabouts of your tickets. If you cannot see any tracking updates within 7 days of receiving the ‘Your order has been shipped’ email, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) so we can help locate your order.

# Trespasser Policy

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2018/07/Trespasser_Meredith-Music-Festival-Octorber-25-2017-20171024-115048.jpg?x16298)

There is a Zero Tolerance Policy in place for anyone trying to gain entry without a valid ticket, by foot, vehicle or other means. This extends to anyone with or without a valid ticket crossing site boundaries including out of bounds areas at any time. This policy has and will continue to be enforced. Such persons are trespassers and are therefore breaking the law. The maximum penalty for trespassing is approximately $4,130 or 6 months imprisonment. Anyone assisting trespassers will be refused entry or ejected, and banned from future events at the site. If a vehicle is found to be carrying or assisting even one trespasser, all occupants of the vehicle will be refused entry.

Any person who attempts to use an invalid or forged wristband to enter the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre will be handed over to Police. Anyone found inside the festival wearing an invalid or forged wristband will be regarded as a trespasser and handed over to Police. The charge is Falsification of a Document, Obtaining Financial Advantage by Deception and Trespass. The maximum penalty for these dishonesty crimes is 10 years’ imprisonment. Alternately a criminal conviction and/or a substantial fine are almost certainties. It is your responsibility to ensure the validity of your wristband. It is not possible to purchase a forged wristband through the Subscriber Ballot or Online Sales.

## **So Please Do Not:**

• attempt entry in any manner without a valid wristband, or  
• trespass on private property, or  
• cross site boundaries including out of bounds areas, or  
• approach or enter/exit the site other than by the authorised entry/exit located at the corner of Meredith-Mount Mercer and Nolan Roads.  
_OR_  
• assist anyone with any of the above.

All wristbands will be checked for proper application by staff.

This information is one of our [policies](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/policies/) and forms part of our [terms and conditions](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/ticket-info/terms-and-conditions/).

# Aunty’s Last Chance

## Menu

Each year, after the tickets have sold out, Aunty considers it a privilege to be able to make available for purchase a quantity of tickets at her discretion, to help look after some Subscribers who tried to get tickets but hit some considerable hurdles along the way.

These most often go to regular Meredith-goers who missed out in the ticket allocations, but also to anyone with a compelling story to tell (and corroborating evidence can be useful…).

Applications for Aunty’s Last Chance have closed for this year.

# The Supernatural Express

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2022/07/mmf-2019-steve-benn-068-lr-1.jpg?x16298)

**The Supernatural Express** – a Direct Bus Service – no stopovers or changeovers and no hassles – is a brilliant way to get to and from the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre with ease. Buses depart from Southern Cross, Thornbury, Geelong and Ballarat.

The service will leave on time, so make sure to arrive at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time.

The Supernatural Express stops at Reception Bus Stop and Top Camp Bus Stop.

Luggage is stored either underneath the bus or at your seat. As a hard and fast rule, the bus can transport the following luggage per person: a bag, a tent and a cooler. Please don’t bring large doof sticks or flags on the bus, nor wagons/carts and marquees. As there just isn’t room.

If you need to bring more gear than what’s allowed, your best bet is to have friends driving a vehicle to bring it for you. Otherwise, you may be interested in [pre-hiring camping gear](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/camping-gear-hire) in advance of the festival, with pick up and return located on-site.

When departing, please check in your luggage all the way through to your end destination by loading your bags in the designated bays before boarding. It is helpful to add labels with your full name and contact number to any items being transported on the bus, for easy identification when unloading, or if items go missing.

When departing on Sunday, please keep in mind that the bus will first collect passengers from Reception Bus Stop, and then from Top Camp Bus Stop. Due to expected traffic on departure day, please allow an additional 30 minutes for your journey.

Getting home safely is part of Meredith. Thanks very much for taking The Supernatural Express. 

_Please note:_ Supernatural Express tickets are now in the form of a QR code, which will be emailed in December. This replaces your name being on a buses doorlist. Please be aware that bus tickets are non-refundable.

* * *

## Direct Bus Service from Southern Cross Station, Naarm/Melbourne

### Friday 11 December 2026

Eleven different departure times are available on Friday – 7am, 7:30am, 8am, 8:30am, 9am, 10am, 11am, 12pm, 1pm, 3pm & 6pm. This service departs from Southern Cross Station bus terminal Bay 56 and travels direct to the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre, stopping at Reception Bus Stop and Top Camp Bus Stop.

### Sunday 13 December 2026

Seven different departure times are available on Sunday – 10am, 11am, 12pm, 1pm, 2pm, 3pm & 4pm. This service departs from Reception Bus Stop, with a pick up at Top Camp Bus Stop before travelling direct to Southern Cross Station bus terminal.

A ticket on The Supernatural Express costs $50 each way (inclusive of booking fee). Bookings can be made by clicking on the button.

[RESERVE MY SEAT ON THE SUPERNATURAL EXPRESS](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/product/bus/the-supernatural-express)

Your bus tickets will be emailed to you in December. Approximate travel time is 2 hours. 

* * *

## The Thornbury Supernatural Express

## Friday 11 December 2026

Eight different departure times are available on Friday – 6:30am, 7am, 7:30am, 8am, 8:30am, 9am, 9:30am & 10am. This service departs from Sir Douglas Nicholls Sporting Complex, Thornbury (near the corner of St Georges Road and Watt Street, enter via Watt Street entrance) and travels direct to the Supernatural Amphitheatre, stopping at Reception Bus Stop and Top Camp Bus Stop.

## Sunday 13 December 2026

Six different departure times are available on Sunday – 11:30am, 12:30pm, 1:30pm, 2:30pm, 3:30pm & 4:30pm. This service departs from Reception Bus Stop, with a pick up at Top Camp Bus Stop before travelling direct to Thornbury.

A ticket on The Thornbury Supernatural Express costs $50 each way (inclusive of booking fee). Bookings can be made by clicking on the button.

[THE THORNBURY SUPERNATURAL EXPRESS](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/product/bus/the-supernatural-express)

Your bus tickets will be emailed to you in December. Approximate travel time is 2.5 hours. 

* * *

## The Geelong Supernatural Express

## Friday 11 December 2026

This service departs at 8am and 11am from the corner of Fenwick Street and Gordon Avenue (opposite Geelong Train Station) and travels direct to the Supernatural Amphitheatre, stopping at Reception Bus Stop and Top Camp Bus Stop.

## Sunday 13 December 2026

This service departs at 12pm and 4pm from Reception Bus Stop, with a pick up at Top Camp Bus Stop before travelling direct to Geelong Station.

A ticket on The Geelong Supernatural Express costs $25 each way (inclusive of booking fee). Bookings can be made by clicking on the button.

[THE GEELONG SUPERNATURAL EXPRESS](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/product/bus/the-supernatural-express)

Your bus tickets will be emailed to you in December. Approximate travel time is 45 minutes.

* * *

## The Ballarat Supernatural Express

### Friday 11 December 2026

This service departs at 8am from Ballarat Train Station (from the bus stop on Lydiard Street North, opposite the Provincial Hotel) and travels direct to the Supernatural Amphitheatre, stopping at Reception Bus Stop and Top Camp Bus Stop.

### Sunday 13 December 2026

This service departs at 4pm from Reception Bus Stop, with a pick up at Top Camp Bus Stop before travelling direct to Ballarat Train Station.

A ticket on The Ballarat Supernatural Express costs $25 each way (inclusive of booking fee). Bookings can be made by clicking on the button.

[THE BALLARAT SUPERNATURAL EXPRESS](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/product/bus/the-supernatural-express)

Your bus tickets will be emailed to you in December. Approximate travel time is 45 minutes.

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2022/09/Buses_GP2020-18-Ben-Fletcher-Low-Resolution-20200308192504-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

## **Supernatural Express FAQs:**

### **What can I bring?**

As a hard and fast rule, the bus can transport the following luggage per person:

*   a bag
*   a tent, single hiking swag or bivvy
*   a cooler (with no ice in it)

If you need to bring more gear than what’s allowed, your best bet is to have friends driving a vehicle to bring it for you. Otherwise, you may be interested in [pre-hiring camping gear](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/camping-gear-hire) in advance of the festival, with pick up and return located on-site.

### **What can’t I bring?**

The same [banned items list](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/banned-items/) that applies for the festival itself also applies for buses. Which means no glass or gas bottles, and various other items.

We also ask that you please don’t bring:

*   large doof sticks or flags (there is no room for them)
*   double swags or swags that wouldn’t otherwise fit in the boot of a car
    
*   coolers pre-filled with ice
    
*   wagons/carts
*   marquees

At the discretion of our Helpers, you’re likely to be asked to dump ice out of your cooler – otherwise it’ll invariably spill on the bus and someone will have to clean it up. You can [purchase ice](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/community-tucker-tent/) when you arrive.

Likewise, you may be refused entry onboard or asked to wait for a later service with more capacity if your luggage is too big.

### **What happens if I miss my bus?**

If you miss your bus, the team will endeavour to get you on the next available one, but you may have to wait a while and there are no guarantees. Being super early is a good way to not miss your bus.

If you get stuck, you can email Aunty via [auntym@mmf.com.au](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) to see what your options might be.

### **Where will I be dropped off at the festival?**

The Supernatural Express stops at both the Reception Bus Stop (H7) and Top Camp Bus Stop (Q9). You can find the [site map here](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/site-map/).

### **I’ve already bought a ticket for the Supernatural Express. Which bus stop can I be picked up from?**

Either Reception Bus Stop (H7) or Top Camp Bus Stop (Q9). The Supernatural Express stops at both of these locations. You can find the [site map here](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/site-map/).

### **Where do I go if I need to catch a bus home on the last day, but didn’t buy a ticket in advance?**

Online sales for all Supernatural Express Services close at 9pm Saturday night. If you find yourself in need of a bus ride home on Sunday, please head to the **Top Camp Bus Stop** and staff will do their best to get you on the next available bus. Card only payments on the day.

The [V/Line Shuttle Bus](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/shuttle-buses/) into Meredith Town (which meets all V/Line services to Geelong and Ballarat on Sunday) leaves from **Reception Bus Stop** and requires neither payment nor registration.

### **I need to** [**cloak my car**](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/car-cloaking/)**. Can I catch a bus home?**

You sure can. The Supernatural Express runs to the following locations on the last day:

*   Southern Cross
*   Thornbury
*   Geelong
*   Ballarat

And a shuttle bus runs into town to meet all V/Line bus services departing Meredith Town for Ballarat and Geelong.

# Contact

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/07/MMF2025_MichaelRidley-HiRes-132-1200x800.jpg?x16298)

## Ask Aunty Meredith

If you can’t find what you are looking for on this website then you can [Ask Aunty Meredith](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au).

## Publicity

For media matters, please go to our [Publicity](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/every-thing/publicity/) page for further information.

## Tickets

If you have purchased tickets Online, in the Ballot or through Aunty’s Last Chance, and you have an enquiry, please contact Aunty – [auntym@mmf.com.au](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au).

## Artist Application

Please go to our [Artist Application](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/every-thing/artist-application/) page for details.

## Caterer Expression of Interest

Please go to our [Caterer Registration](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/every-thing/caterer-registration/) page for details.

* * *

### How to access Help: in person

*   [Helper Hut Central](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/supernatural-amphitheatre/helper-hut-central/) – located to the right of the stage, available 24 hours.
*   Your local [Helper Hut](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/helpers/) – there are 14 Helper Huts staffed 24 hours. Volunteer Helpers and private security also rove the campgrounds and Amphitheatre. They can help too.
*   On-site [First Aid](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/supernatural-amphitheatre/first-aid/) – located to the right of the stage, available 24 hours.
*   On-site [Welfare](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/supernatural-amphitheatre/welfare/) – located to the right of the stage, available 24 hours.
*   The on-site [Police Station](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/supernatural-amphitheatre/police-station/) – also located to the right of the stage.

### How to access Help: other options

*   Call or text our Helpers directly on [0430 091 120](tel:+61430091120), available 24 hours.
*   Email [auntym@mmf.com.au](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au), available 24 hours.
*   Call 000 (or 112 if you do not have mobile reception). Emergency Services request not to use social media to report an incident or emergency.
*   Download [Safety](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/09/MSA-Safety.pdf?x69280) information, which includes contacts for off-site support.

# Subscriber Info

## Menu

![](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/07/GP2025_Benjamin-Fletcher_288-1200x801.jpg?x16298)

Here’s some additional information for our Subscribers.

Your history with us is very important, particularly when it comes to the Ballot. The longer you have been a Subscriber, the better chance you have of scoring in the Ballot.

So, if you have changed your email address and can no longer access your previous email to update your details, please [email Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au?subject=Please%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address&body=Hi%20Aunty%2C%0D%0A%0D%0APlease%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20to%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AMy%20old%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20is%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AThank%20you!) and advise your previous email and your new email. We will update your details. From time to time we also clean the database of inactive Subscribers; if you have been inactive for some time and would like to reactivate your account, please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au?subject=Please%20reactivate%20my%20Subscriber%20account).

Wherever possible, please use the same email address for entering the Ballot and making your ticket purchases each year. Having your history attached to one email account improves your Ballot chances. Please [contact Aunty](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au?subject=Please%20consolidate%20my%20Ballot%20history&body=Hi%20Aunty%2C%0D%0A%0D%0APlease%20update%20my%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20to%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AMy%20old%20Subscriber%20email%20address%20is%3A%0D%0A%0D%0AThank%20you!) if you would like to consolidate your Ballot history.

### Moved House?

You can adjust your delivery address via your [Supernatural Ticket Centre](https://tickets.mmf.com.au/subscriber) account. From the Account Details page, scroll down to the Delivery Name and Address heading and edit your address by clicking on the edit icon on the right and entering in your correct address. Your delivery address will be automatically updated for any orders that are yet to be packed.

Instinct over Algorithm

Feeling over System

Body over Machine

Equine Finality

There’s a New Racehorse in town. A new thoroughbred at the stables. And the head-shy, four-legged, fast-moving freak was built on zeros and ones. Metal and wires, it speaks in binary.

You. You. You are the horse. 

Sometimes the horse believed the universe had spoken to it. But the static of the world drove it into a deep, dark cocoon. 

And it felt nothing.

And it felt everything.

And it became darkness.

And it became light. 

And then it eclosed.

And it felt kindness.

And it felt trusted.

And it felt respected. 

And it became nothing.

And it became everything. 

And the universe said you are the universe tasting itself, talking to itself, reading its own code.

And you are the horse. 

And the horse is you. 

And you are the universe. 

And the universe is love.

### about

Instinct over Algorithm  
  
Feeling over System  
  
Body over Machine  
  
Equine Finality  
  
There’s a New Racehorse in town. A new thoroughbred at the stables. And the head-shy, four-legged, fast-moving freak was built on zeros and ones. Metal and wires, it speaks in binary.  
  
You. You. You are the horse.  
  
Sometimes the horse believed the universe had spoken to it. But the static of the world drove it into a deep, dark cocoon.  
  
And it felt nothing.  
  
And it felt everything.  
  
And it became darkness.  
  
And it became light.  
  
And then it eclosed.  
  
And it felt kindness.  
  
And it felt trusted.  
  
And it felt respected.  
  
And it became nothing.  
  
And it became everything.  
  
And the universe said you are the universe tasting itself, talking to itself, reading its own code.  
  
And you are the horse.  
  
And the horse is you.  
  
And you are the universe.  
  
And the universe is love.
