Let's dance along with Shikyu♪ 2026.04.09 [![](https://www.gooutcamp.jp/jamboree/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/GOUT5193.HIKARUFUNYU-1024x683.jpg)](https://www.gooutcamp.jp/jamboree/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/GOUT5193.HIKARUFUNYU.jpg) "GO OUT Ondo ," with lyrics written by Japan's most tear-jerking comedy band, Yonkyu, will be performed on April 11th (Sat) at 8:30 PM at the FUJI-SAN STAGE, with dance phrases submitted by everyone to complete the song! Whether or not your phrases were selected, thank you to everyone who helped us brainstorm the GO OUT Ondo song. Let's dance together on the day! Here, we'll first reveal the completed lyrics for GO OUT Ondo. * * * \[GO OUT Ondo\] I want to teach you, and yet I want to hide it, I want to dance at the foot of Mt. Fuji Let's keep singing　the GO OUT Ondo, the temperature at Fumotoppara rises It's a nice place, a nice place, a really nice place. We all go into the tent together at least once (it's a nice place). Even if you forget your condiments, you can ask around and someone will lend you some (it's a great place). I bring several gas canisters with me, but　 I never use up a single one (it's eco-friendly, you know). I'm going to give my beloved camping gear a name (Peg Taro) I probably forgot something, but that meant I had more free time. Fill the space with unforgettable memories. I want to tell you, but I also want to keep it a secret: everything tastes good when grilled over charcoal. Let's try to find the Big Dipper. My body is aching all morning when I wake up. It's a nice place, a nice place, a really nice place. I get flustered when I can't light a fire in front of a girl (but that's a good thing). I love campfires, but when I get home I always think, "Ugh, it stinks!" (But it's a good thing.) The luggage that was in there when I arrived won't fit on the way back (it's a good place). Age, gender, occupation don't matter (it's a good place) I'm already thinking about my next plans while I'm tidying up. Leave it more beautiful than you found it, and pass the baton to someone tomorrow. You and I are proof that we both lived, souls that survived through history. GO OUT Ondo for Tomorrow Let's live until we meet again It's a nice place, a nice place, a really nice place. Please review the following information before attending. **For those using** **eplus** Due to the large number of attendees, the signal may be unstable. To ensure smooth entry, please download your ticket from the eplus app before arriving at the venue. ( Downloading your ticket will allow you to complete the entry process even offline. ) Click here for the eplus ticket usage guide [: https://eplus.jp/sf/guide/spticket](https://eplus.jp/sf/guide/spticket) **Regarding campsite use on Friday,** April 10th , some campsites will be unavailable. Please be aware that the affected areas are around the red lines on the map below. ![](https://www.gooutcamp.jp/jamboree/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/aaddf11964eb767f298ce5f7d7855232-e1775723730106.png) **Regarding temporary toilets:** In addition to the permanent toilets, temporary toilets will also be available at the venue. These temporary toilets will be available for use from 10:00 AM on Saturday, April 11th. The temporary toilets near the central grassland toilets will also be available from the morning of Saturday, April 11th. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to visitors arriving from Friday, April 10th onwards, and appreciate your understanding. **Weather forecast for Friday** Heavy rain is forecast for Friday. Therefore, there may be waiting times or delays in entering the park. Please be aware of this in advance. Wind is also forecast. When setting up tents, please consider the weather conditions and prioritize safety. Also, temperatures have been low for the past few days, and it has been quite cold at night. Please prepare plenty of warm clothing. **Regarding the entrance gate for each parking ticket** : The entrance gate varies depending on the parking ticket. Please check the following and head to the entrance gate corresponding to your parking ticket. ![](https://www.gooutcamp.jp/jamboree/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/bbe48e26fc403b89bc107d232c5ebaf0.jpg) **Fumoto Village Campsite** Please come directly to Fuji Auto Campground Fumoto Village. 174-1 Fumoto, Fujinomiya City, Shizuoka Prefecture [(Google Map)](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kz3jwygFS6sCNSGJ9) **Regarding Day-Trip Parking** Initially, we planned to have parking near Fumotoppara accessible by shuttle bus, but this has been changed to parking within the main venue, Fumotoppara. Therefore, those using day-trip parking tickets should head towards the main venue, Fumotoppara. **If you** have a 2-night, 3-day admission ticket and wish to enter from Saturday, you can enter between 8:30 and 17:00 on Saturday. ## ![pink-instagram](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/about-page/001.webp)

SHOP名である”atmos (アトモス)”は、atmosphere(大気)から由来し、大気のようにそこにあって当然のようなSHOPでありたい。  
“atmos”は、2000年、東京・原宿にヘッドショップをオープン。ファッションとしてのスニーカーをテーマに、店内はスニーカーウォールを設置。  
ナショナルブランドとのコラボレーションやエクスクルーシブモデルをはじめ、最新プロダクトのテストローンチやマーケティングなど東京のスニーカーカルチャーを世界に向けて発信しています。  
  
The name "atmos" is derived from the word “atmosphere." The goal is to be a store that feels as naturally present and indispensable as the atmosphere itself. atmos opened its flagship store in Harajuku, Tokyo in 2000, centered around the concept of sneakers as a fashion item, the store featured a distinctive sneaker wall display. Through collaborations with major brands and the creation of exclusive models, and various marketing initiatives, atmos continues to share Tokyo's sneaker culture with the world.

## ![pink-instagram](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/about-page/002.webp)

東京のスニーカーカルチャーを世界に向けて発信し続けるショップ「atmos」より誕生した、16歳-29歳のGEN-Z世代の女性をターゲットにしたWOMEN’s SNEAKER SELECT SHOP。  
"Pink’s Street"をコンセプトに掲げ、MUSIC、ART、DANCE、SPORTSなどストリートにある様々なカルチャーの要素を取り入れた、独自のストリートスタイルを提唱。  
スニーカースタイルを軸に、デイリーに取り入れられるオリジナルアパレルを展開し、スポーツミックスなストリートスタイル"Pink’s street"を日常に提案します。  
  
Born from atmos, the Tokyo-based store known for sharing sneaker culture with the world, atmos pink is a women’s sneaker select shop created for the Gen Z women. Built around the concept of “Pink Street,” the brand promotes a unique street style that incorporates diverse cultural influences found in street culture, including music, art, dance, and sports. Centered on sneaker fashion, the shop offers original apparel designed for everyday wear and proposes “Pink Street,” a sporty, street-inspired lifestyle that can be seamlessly integrated into daily life.

## ![pink-instagram](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/about-page/003.webp)

「TOKYO 23（トウキョウ 23）」は、Jordan Brand に特化したコンセプトショップとして2016年に東京・原宿にオープン。“Basketball × Street Culture” をコンセプトに掲げ、バスケットボールを軸としたファッション、音楽、アートなど、多様なカルチャーをクロスオーバーさせた独自のバスケットボールカルチャーを発信しています。  
また、バスケットボールマーケットにおける新たなプラットフォームとして、競技者やコミュニティに向けた新しいアプローチを展開。スポーツとストリートカルチャーを融合した新たな価値を提案し続けています。  
  
TOKYO 23 is a concept shop dedicated to Jordan Brand that opened in Harajuku, Tokyo in 2016. Built around the concept of “Basketball × Street Culture,” it showcases a unique basketball culture that blends diverse cultural elements including fashion, music, art, and other diverse influences that pay homage to the game of basketball. In addition, as a new platform within the basketball market, TOKYO 23 develops innovative approaches for athletes and local communities. By merging sports and street culture, it continues to create and propose new forms of value and expression.

## ![pink-instagram](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/about-page/004.webp)

原宿から世界へスニーカーカルチャーを発信し続ける「atmos」と、スポーツとストリートの歴史を築いてきた「adidas Originals」によるコラボレーションショップ。  
“RETRO & NEW”をコンセプトに、ブランドのアーカイブと最新プロダクトを融合。スニーカーを軸に、音楽・アート・ファッションなど多彩なカルチャーが交差するコミュニティスペースとして、東京から新たなスタイルと体験を世界へ発信します。  
  
A.T.A.D is a collaborative concept shop between atmos, the Harajuku-based brand that continues to share sneaker culture with the world, and adidas Originals, a pioneer in shaping the history of sport and street culture. Built on the concept of “RETRO & NEW,” the space fuses the brand’s archive with its latest products. Centered around sneakers, it serves as a community space where music, art, and fashion intersect for the better of the culture, sharing new styles and experiences from Tokyo to audiences all over the world.

# Hobart  
Twilight Market

*   Eats
*   Drinks
*   Design
*   Music

The ultimate Friday night out. Taste Tasmania's best food and drinks, browse local makers, enjoy live music, and soak up a relaxed, family and dog friendly atmosphere.

[All Market Dates](https://hobarttwilightmarket.com.au/#dates)[Apply as a stallholder](https://hobarttwilightmarket.com.au/#stallholder)

Also from us — [Tasmanian Produce Market](https://hobarttwilightmarket.com.au/tasmanian-produce-market)

## About Us

At the Hobart Twilight Market, we strive to create a warm and welcoming atmosphere where you can enjoy live music from local talent and indulge in Tasmania's finest quality products. Our market is home to a diverse range of food and locally-crafted small batch drinks, as well as an array of design stalls.

We take pride in our passionate stallholders who are eager to share their unique stories with you. Our market provides access to toilets, a playground (Long Beach only), accessible parking, a dedicated information booth, and a fee-free cash-out facility. We welcome dogs and families and hope to create a truly enjoyable experience for all who attend.

Make sure you follow our social channels to learn more about what you can expect when visiting.

🦮 Dog Friendly👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Friendly♿ Accessible🅿️ Accessible Parking

![Hobart Twilight Market](/htm-about.jpg)![Market stalls](/htm-about-1.jpg)![Market atmosphere](/htm-about-2.jpg)

## There's so much to see & do at Hobart Twilight Market

From street food to live music, discover everything our market has to offer.

![Street Food](/htm-street-food.webp)

### Street Food

Welcome to foodie heaven! Chow down on a diverse range of gourmet treats from local street traders and a sizeable food truck line-up. Grab a bite to eat as you peruse the markets, or make a meal of it, sit back and enjoy the people-watching.

![Local Produce](/htm-local-produce.webp)

### Local Produce

Get to know the farmers behind your produce whilst you fill your bag with locally grown fruit, veggies and plants. The perfect place to stock up on your weekly goods, with everything from farm-fresh seasonal produce to homemade artisanal treats.

![Design](/htm-design.webp)

### Design

Browse the eclectic craft stalls, boasting an impressive range of local homewares and goodies you didn't even know you needed. Jewellery, gifts, books, homewares and many other eclectic surprises await you.

![Live Music](/htm-live-music.webp)

### Live Music

Let the afternoon slip away to the chilled tunes of live and local talented artists, entertainers and musicians against a picturesque backdrop. A perfect place to sit back and spend the afternoon with family, friends and dogs too!

![Fashion](/htm-fashion.webp)

### Fashion

A perfectly fashionable Friday night shopping experience! Always a hub of creativity, you can shop and explore the latest from local designers, makers and entrepreneurs, as well as find pre-loved items to spice up your wardrobe.

![Refreshments](/htm-refreshments.webp)

### Refreshments

Find a new favourite as you sip your way through some of the region's finest beverages, with everything from locally made liquors, cocktails, cordials and wines to quaff or savour.

## One city, two amazing market locations

Experience Hobart's Twilight Market at two stunning waterfront locations.

![Long Beach, Sandy Bay](/htm-long-beach.webp)

Pop Up Series

### Long Beach, Sandy Bay

Experience Hobart's iconic Twilight Market, located on the picturesque Long Beach. Delicious food, live music and local crafts.

**Where?**17 Beach Road, Lower Sandy Bay — 10-min drive from Hobart CBD. Catch a Metro bus or hire a scooter.

**When?**Select Fridays 4:30pm – 9:00pm (Oct–Mar) + Sunday Pop Up Series 11:00am – 3:00pm (Jun–Sep)

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/place/42%C2%B054'37.4%22S+147%C2%B021'23.2%22E/@-42.91038,147.356451,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d-42.91038!4d147.356451?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDcxNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)

![Brooke St Pier](/htm-brooke-st.webp)

### Brooke St Pier

Discover Hobart's vibrant Twilight Market, located at Brooke Street Pier. Shop, eat and connect with the local community.

**Where?**12 Franklin Wharf, Hobart TAS 7000 — in the heart of the city, easily accessible by foot or public transport.

**When?**Select Fridays 4:30pm – 9:00pm. Dates are subject to change — check our website and socials for updates.

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Brooke+Street+Pier/@-42.8847445,147.33021,17z)
